name: maple-court-hoa
note: The synthesis a correct model would return from the four HOA PDFs in tmp-test-docs (see scripts/make-test-documents.js). This is what the report tool's input looks like BEFORE any of the post-processing runs — the model's own risk_score, its typed percent_funded, one finding whose citations will not resolve, and an empty missing_or_uncertain. Every figure traces to a document, and the right answers are recorded in scripts/hoa-pipeline-harness.js.

1.cited_text: Current reserve balance (as of 09/30/2021) $486,000. Fully funded balance $1,620,000. Percent funded 30.0%. Recommended annual reserve contribution $210,000.

2.cited_text: Roof membrane replacement (remaining life 8 years, due 2029) $840,000

4.cited_text: Owner delinquency over 90 days stood at 12.4% of units as of the November 2025 financial statement.

5.cited_text: MOTION carried 4-1 to establish a $250,000 line of credit with Commonwealth Community Bank, secured against future assessments, to provide interim funding for roof work.

6.cited_text: The agent reported that the master policy renewal carries a 5% named-storm deductible, increased from a flat $25,000 at the prior renewal.

7.cited_text: 11.1 No more than twenty percent (20%) of the units in the Association may be leased at any one time.

8.cited_text: As of the date of this certificate, seventeen (17) of the eighty-four (84) units are leased, which is the maximum permitted under Article XI. Nine (9) owners are presently on the leasing waiting list.

9.cited_text: 12.1 Upon each conveyance of a unit, the purchaser shall pay to the Association a working capital contribution equal to two (2) months of the then-current regular assessment.

report.risk_rationale: Reserves are thin and the budget funds well below the study's recommendation, but nothing has been formally assessed yet.
report.headline: Reserves are thin against a roof due in 2029, and the board has opened a line of credit
report.summary: Maple Court holds $486,000 against a fully funded balance of $1,620,000 and contributes $60,000 a year where its own study recommends $210,000. The roof is due in 2029 at $840,000.

short_term_risk.rationale: Nothing has been levied, but the board has already sought interim funding.
short_term_risk.basis: No assessment has been announced in the minutes provided.

mid_term_risk.rationale: At the current contribution the fund reaches $666,000 by 2029 against an $840,000 roof, a gap of $174,000.

reserve_health.assessment: The association is funding reserves at under a third of what its own study recommends.

leasing.current_status: 17 of 17 permitted leases in use; 9 owners on the waiting list
leasing.owner_occupancy_requirement: One year of owner occupancy before leasing
leasing.detail: You could not rent this unit out on purchase. The cap is full and leasing rights do not transfer with the unit.

sections.title: What this means for you
